text: {Name} worked the family ferry near {Place} until fighting destroyed the boat. Living with their mother afterward, they began learning the recipes the family used for celebrations.
self_review: A ferry worker loses the family boat in fighting, lives with their mother, and learns to cook for family celebrations.
source_pattern: The supplied research documents destroyed or lost livelihoods and survival with family; it does not document this cooking relationship.
fictional_changes: The ferry, boat loss, living arrangement, and recipes are plausible inventions. No historical person is claimed as their source.
